drhp.business: Kabra Extrusiontechnik Limited operates through two core segments. Its legacy Extrusion Machinery business manufactures plastic extrusion systems for pipe and blown film/flexible packaging applications, serving domestic and international customers. The GEON division designs, integrates, and manufactures lithium-ion battery packs for electric vehicles (2W, 3W, 4W, CV) and stationary energy storage applications, operating a technology-agnostic model with in-house R&D.
